# ELK.js 0.12.0

Unmodified [npm bundle](https://registry.npmjs.org/elkjs/-/elkjs-0.12.0.tgz), [source](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/v0.12.0), [EPL-2.0 license](ELK-LICENSE.md). Runs locally without a layout service.

To update, replace the bundle and license from npm, then run viewer tests.
